scope: four manuscript sources and main/supplement PDF text

findings.problem: Initial text presented CE reconstruction improvement as a counterexample to improved generation, although CE also improves every matched MSE21 generation distance; LSTM lacks the reconstruction task.
findings.requested_change: Separate matched CE/MSE improvement from failure to surpass external LSTM comparator; remove ranking-reversal and concrete-counterexample claims.

findings.problem: Initial main text supplies cohort counts/hashes but not database provenance, admission/group split and descriptor scale-fitting rules; supplement omits operational family/source union thresholds.
findings.requested_change: Add concise actual source/filter/split/scaler and grouping definitions already available in frozen evidence, without accessing held-out data.

findings.problem: Initial prose leaves pooled-count JS/L1/entropy versus sequence-averaged feature-MMD unclear; decoder tie and length-one dipeptide behavior omitted.
findings.requested_change: State pooled count normalization, zero pair feature for length one, and smallest-prefix tie resolution.

findings.problem: QMAP described only as an AMP benchmark next to generation study can obscure that it is MIC/hemolytic regression, not a generation benchmark.
findings.requested_change: Explicitly name MIC/hemolytic regression in main Introduction.
